meta.privacy_statement: No private street addresses, precise home/storage locations of private collections, or sensitive personal data appear in this file. Custodians and locations are recorded at city/institution granularity. EXCEPTION: published street addresses of public museums/landmarks (7 records, all public institutions) are retained as published; the normalization rule applies to private and ambiguous locations. Privacy-limited records carry explicit privacy_note values; do not attempt to resolve them.

counts.note: Merged records (JPC, HistoryMakers, BMRC, Shorefront, SSCAC, Obsidian) appear once; origin counts sum above the canonical total.

meta.grade_policy: Record-level grades follow the track evidence standard (Verified/Provisional/Disputed/Unresolved). Where tracks disagreed on an extent point value, the documented range is given and the conflict noted. No grade conflict at merged-record level required weakening; see SYNTHESIS-NOTES.md.
